history.text: Born as the second son of a tenant farmer in the borderlands.
Settles in Dagsion, making a living as a mercenary.
Grows stronger through countless chaotic battles.
Becomes known among other mercenaries as the Unkillable Guzran.

likes: Booze, women, interesting people, young greenhorns.
dislikes: Those who manipulate others, humble living.
